title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Patient presents today for follow-up regarding management of type 2 diabetes and recent episode of hypoglycemia.

History of Present Illness
The patient is a known case of type 2 diabetes. Today’s visit was prompted by a recent hypoglycemic episode. Review of intake suggests dietary indiscretion preceded the event. The patient was advised to continue managing T2DM with diet and exercise.

Medication List
None at this time.

Exam
Vitals are stable. Physical exam is within normal limits.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus: The patient requires continued management with diet and exercise to maintain stability.
2. Hypoglycemic episode: Requires follow-up education on recognizing and treating future hypoglycemic episodes.

Plan
Continue current management plan focusing on diet and exercise for T2DM. Patient educated on sick-day rules and signs/symptoms of hypoglycemia. Follow up in three months.
explanations: Diabetes with hypoglycemia and no coma documented: E11.649.

distractors.why: Hypoglycemia is a complication with its own code.
